tour_type.morning: 🌉 Chain Bridge: Kick off the morning with a breezy walk across the Danube — nothing too hardcore, just good vibes and iconic views. Perfect way to wake up without actually doing much. → | 🏰 Buda Castle: Cruise up the hill (walking = fitness, funicular = vibes) and explore royal courtyards, old-school stone passages and picture spots that make you look like a pro photographer without trying. → | ⛪ Matthias Church: That roof? Absolute art. The whole place feels like the designers just said “let’s go wild.” Gothic inside, fairytale outside. → | 🏯 Fisherman’s Bastion: Insta-mode ON. White towers, castle-like terraces and a city panorama that slaps. → | 🍰 Ruszwurm Café: Reward time! Tiny historic café where the cakes taste like someone’s grandma still checks quality control.
tour_type.afternoon: ⛪ St. Stephen’s Basilica: Grand, golden and gorgeous. Step inside for the wow-factor; climb the terrace for the *super* wow-factor. → | 🏛️ Andrássy Avenue: Budapest’s classy runway — mansions, boutiques, cafés, leafy sidewalks… basically a chill stroll with fancy scenery. → | 🏺 House of Terror Museum: Serious topic, but very respectfully and thoughtfully done. Clear timeline, strong atmosphere, and an important part of understanding the city. → | 🍽️ Paprika Restaurant: Time to recharge with home-style Hungarian comfort food — soups, stews, dumplings, and veggie picks. Warm, casual, all-around cozy.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Margaret Island: This is Budapest’s chill pill — fountains, running paths (no need to run though 😄), gardens and a soft, golden sunset glow. Pure peace. → OR → ⛴️ Danube Cruise: If you want the dramatic cinematic version — Parliament lights up, bridges sparkle, and the whole river turns into liquid gold. Zero effort, maximum enjoyment.
tour_type.night: 🎨 Szimpla Kert: Probably the most famous ruin-art courtyard on Earth — colorful, weird, creative, and awesome. Atmosphere only! → | 🌿 Mazel Tov: Beautiful urban-jungle courtyard with plants, fairy lights and feel-good energy. Basically cozy but fancy-but-not-too-fancy. → | 🎭 Kisüzem: Small creative spot where locals hang out — artsy, laid-back, friendly. Zero stress. → | ⚠️ Teen note: These are atmosphere descriptions only; some venues have age restrictions, so this is just the vibe overview.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Chain Bridge → Buda Castle → Matthias Church → Fisherman’s Bastion → Ruszwurm Café.; Afternoon: St. Stephen’s Basilica → Andrássy Avenue → House of Terror Museum → Paprika Restaurant.; Sunset: Margaret Island or Danube Cruise.; Night: Szimpla Kert → Mazel Tov → Kisüzem (atmosphere only; age restrictions may apply).

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Main Square: Start the morning in Szentendre’s super cute, colorful center — baroque façades, tiny shops, street art corners and that Mediterranean-cafe vibe that makes you slow down instantly. → | 🖼️ Serbian Orthodox Museum: Small but meaningful, full of shiny icons and centuries of stories — perfect quick culture boost. → | 🏘️ Old Town Baroque Streets: Wander the winding alleys with pastel houses and little galleries that pop out of nowhere. Zero pressure, just explore at your own pace. → | ☕ Café Dorothea: Chill break time — good coffee, calm terrace, and the kind of atmosphere that makes you forget what time it is.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏡 Skanzen Open-Air Museum: Step into a mini time-travel village tour — traditional houses, workshops, barns and rural scenes from all across Hungary. Easily a few hours of ‘wow this is adorable’ moments. → | 🍲 Local Lunch: Home-style soups, goulash, paprikash, fresh pastries… basically everything your grandma would approve of. Warm, simple, comforting.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside Walk: Golden hour here hits so softly — calm water, tree-lined paths and the kind of peaceful silence that feels like a deep breath. → OR → ⛴️ Short Boat Ride: Gentle Danube cruise with nature, river breeze and beautiful waterfront views. Zero effort required — just float and enjoy.
tour_type.night: 🎨 Art-House Cafés: Szentendre is an artsy town, so expect cozy spots filled with paintings, handmade decor, little lamps and creative vibes. Great for teen-friendly chill time. → | 🌙 Riverside Chill: Soft lights, quiet benches, slow-flowing river — nothing but calm energy for ending the day on a peaceful note.

tour_type.afternoon: 🌉 Mária Valéria Bridge: Take a chill walk across the border into Slovakia and back — international cardio 😄 plus awesome river scenery. → | 🏘️ Old Town Streets: Wander pastel lanes, tiny artisan shops and cute corners that appear out of nowhere. Zero rush, full charm. → | 🖼️ Christian Museum (optional): If you’re feeling artsy — medieval paintings, sacred treasures and calm gallery vibes. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Danube vibes: Fish soup, stews, dumplings, veggie picks… warm, homey, local comfort flavors.

You earned it.

tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Citadel Lookout: Head back up to catch golden hour wrapping around the entire Danube Bend — one of those sunsets you remember without even trying. Calm, cinematic and absolutely gorgeous.
tour_type.night: 🌙 Riverside Evening Walk: Soft lights, quiet water, cool night air — the perfect slow ending to a day full of views and mini-adventures.

Perfect for wandering and discovering cute, unexpected corners. → | 🕌 Mosque of Pasha Qasim: A super unique mix of Ottoman and Christian architecture right on the main square — history blended in one building. → | 🍽️ Local Lunch: Mediterranean-inspired dishes, pastries, soups and warm flavors that match Pécs’ sunny vibe.

tour_type.night: 🌙 Király Street: The heart of the city comes alive with lively-but-chill cafés, cozy corners and evening street vibes perfect for a relaxed nighttime stroll.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Győr Old Town: Start your day wandering through colorful façades, little plazas and narrow streets that look like they were made for slow exploring. Everything feels soft, calm and super walkable — exactly the morning mood we want. → | ⛪ Cathedral Basilica of the Assumption: Step inside for a peaceful moment surrounded by elegant details and a calm interior that feels miles away from city noise. → | ☕ Baroque Square Café: The perfect mid-morning pause — cozy seats, pretty architecture around you, and that classic small-city chill energy.
tour_type.afternoon: 🎨 Rába-Quelle Riverside Walk: Gentle riverside paths, breezy air and easy steps — ideal for relaxing without actually doing anything too fancy. → | 🏺 Museums of Győr: Art, local history, regional stories and small exhibitions you can enjoy at your own pace. Perfect for a low-pressure cultural boost. → | 🍽️ Local Lunch: Warm soups, hearty stews, tasty pastries and veggie-friendly picks — Győr comfort food at its finest.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Rába–Mosoni-Danube Confluence: A seriously cool natural spot where rivers meet — sunset light reflects on the water, and the whole place gets that peaceful golden glow.
tour_type.night: 🌙 Old-Town Lights & Dessert Spots: Evening in Győr is mellow and cozy — glowing old-town streets, dessert cafés, soft lights and a super safe, relaxed atmosphere for an easy nighttime stroll.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Old Town → Cathedral → Baroque Square café.; Afternoon: Riverside walk → Museums → Local lunch.; Sunset: River confluence golden hour.; Night: Old-Town dessert walk.

interest_descriptions.History & Churches 🏰: Discover Győr’s rich historical heritage through its cathedral, centuries-old buildings and important city landmarks.
interest_descriptions.Art & Museums 🎨: Visit local museums, galleries and creative spaces showcasing regional art, history and cultural collections.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Firewatch Tower: Start your Sopron adventure with the city’s iconic landmark — climb up for panoramic views, medieval vibes and that ‘wow, this town is adorable’ feeling from above. → | 🏛️ Main Square Walk: Colorful houses, arches, frescoes and charming old-town corners everywhere you look. Easy pace, great photos, zero stress. → | ☕ Old-Town Café: Time for a calm morning drink in a cozy spot surrounded by centuries-old façades and soft town ambience.
tour_type.afternoon: 🎨 Sopron Museums: Dive into local history, medieval collections and cultural stories — small, enjoyable and perfect for a chill cultural boost. → | 🌳 Lővérek Forest Walk: Fresh forest air, gentle hills, leafy paths and peaceful green vibes — ideal reset in nature. → | 🍽️ Local Lunch: Hearty soups, comforting dishes, pastries and veggie-friendly options. Warm and very Sopron in flavor.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Forest Lookout Points: Head up to one of Sopron’s hillside viewpoints — golden sunlight over rolling hills, rooftops and endless trees. Soft, peaceful and seriously photogenic.
tour_type.night: 🌙 Old Town Streets: Quiet stone alleys glowing with warm lights, charming dessert spots and that small-town calm that makes evening walks feel extra cozy.

tour_type.morning: 🌊 Tagore Promenade: Start the day with the classic Balaton mood — calm lake views, tree-lined paths and that early-morning breeze that instantly upgrades your energy. Perfect slow-walk territory. → | 🌿 Annagora Park Lookout (non-water areas): Head up for a wide, dreamy panorama over the lake — the kind that makes you say “okay, this place is actually stunning.” → | ☕ Lakeside Café: Chill break time with soft morning light, quiet water and a cozy café setup that feels like a mini holiday moment.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏛️ Round Church & Town Center: Small but charming architectural highlights — cute details, warm colors and that peaceful Balaton-town vibe. → | 🌳 Koloska Valley Nature Walk: Forest air, gentle trails, birds, shade… basically total nature therapy without any effort required. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Balaton Specialties: Light soups, freshwater fish dishes, tasty veggie picks — fresh, summery, easy-going flavors.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Tagore Promenade Sunset: The lake turns gold, the sky goes soft-pink, and everything slows down. A classic Balaton moment — simple but unforgettable.
tour_type.night: 🌙 Marina Evening Walk: Calm lights reflecting on the water, boats gently rocking and dessert spots waiting for you to grab something sweet. Super chill, super safe, super relaxing.

tour_type.morning: ⛪ Tihany Abbey: Start your day at the most iconic spot of the peninsula — peaceful courtyards, quiet hilltop breezes and a panoramic view over Balaton that instantly sets the tone. Historic, calm and beautifully placed above the lake. → | 🌿 Lavender House Visitor Center: Learn the story behind Tihany’s beloved lavender fields — from traditions to scents to local history. Small, charming and super relaxing. → | ☕ Abbey Hill Café: Time for a lakeside coffee break with fresh pastries and soft morning light drifting over the water.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌾 Lavender Trails (seasonal): Gentle walking paths through purple fields in summertime — calm, fragrant and perfect for slow, dreamy exploring. → | 🧵 Craft Shops: Handmade lavender goodies, ceramics, soaps, tiny artworks — great for browsing cute local products. → | 🍽️ Local Lunch: Light soups, freshwater fish dishes, dumplings and veggie-friendly picks — warm, homey and very Tihany.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Echo Hill Lookout: One of the best viewpoints in the area — glowing orange reflections on the lake and soft evening air. Peaceful, cinematic and seriously beautiful.
tour_type.night: 🌙 Old Village Evening Walk: Quiet stone streets, warm lights, little craft shops glowing softly — the perfect calm ending to a lavender-scented day.

tour_type.morning: 🌊 Siófok Waterfront Promenade: Start your day with calm Balaton breeze, open lake views and that soft morning light that feels like a natural reset button. Perfect for a slow, peaceful warm-up walk. → | 🌺 Millennium Park: Colorful flowers, fountains, sculptures and wide green corners — super photogenic and super relaxing. → | ☕ Beachside Café: Grab a cozy morning drink right by the water — gentle waves, comfy seats and lazy-lake energy included.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏖️ Golden Beach Walk (non-swim areas): Long, sunlit waterfront paths ideal for easy strolling, taking photos and soaking up the Balaton vibe without rushing. → | 🎭 City Center Art Corners: Explore fun murals, creative sculptures and laid-back street-art spots scattered around the center — bright colors and youthful vibes everywhere. → | 🍽️ Balaton-Style Lunch: Fresh lake dishes, soups, grilled plates, pastries and light veggie options — summery, simple and super tasty.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Siófok Pier: One of the absolute best sunset viewpoints on the lake — glowing sky colors, golden reflections on the water and that quiet, dreamy Balaton mood. Bring your camera or just enjoy the moment.
tour_type.night: 🌙 Promenade & Dessert Spots: Evening in Siófok can be lively but stays friendly — glowing paths, gentle breeze, dessert cafés and ice-cream spots perfect for a soft, cozy night walk.
